The activity panel now redraws once every two seconds, also while several agents run.

- In `/desk-activity`, each step of a running agent redrew the panel at once, so with two or more agent rails the bars and the elapsed time moved several times a second. The panel now takes in what changed at its two-second clock. Scrolling and unfolding an agent still respond at once

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
